run_image_caption_inference: run image caption inference on an image file using the ImageCaptionInferencer class
list_image_caption_models: list all available image caption model names using the list_models static method
visualize_image_caption_results: visualize image caption predictions with optional resize and show parameters
preprocess_images_for_caption: preprocess a list of images into batched data for caption inference
postprocess_caption_predictions: postprocess DataSample predictions into a list of pred_caption dictionaries
